answer Notes: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka, sent to gather three seal-stones that open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire (drowned tower off Lilmoth, reached by diving from Bell Station) so I can use the Eye of Argonia at the Root to heal the sick Hist trees. I now hold one stone, the Seal-Stone of the Kings, from Blackrose Prison: I paid Corvus 300 gold to enter as a guest, pickpocketed the vault key from raj-kaal Okaz-Teel, and took the stone from the Warden Chest. I also carry the Warden Vault Key. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, was in the hall and I left him alone. Still to get: the stones in the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (boat near Noota Nara).
